diff-interval-claims.alt: Three confidence intervals for the true difference in mean reading score, headphones minus no headphones, each centered at 4.5 points: 90% from 1.35 to 7.65, 95% from 0.72 to 8.28 and 99% from −0.53 to 9.53. A dashed line at 0 lies left of the 90% and 95% intervals but inside the 99% interval. A second dashed line at 5 points, the school's threshold, lies inside all three.
